## SkipLink
Accessible bypass navigation using the configured preset's public helper.

<a name="exp_components.module_SkipLink--module.exports"></a>

### .module.exports() ⇒ <code>JSX.Element</code> ⏏
Render the UI kit's focus-revealed skip link.

The kit exposes this accessibility helper only through its preset prefix;
resolving the prefix from the manifest keeps it aligned with site configuration.

**Kind**: static method of [<code>SkipLink</code>](#components.module_SkipLink)
**Returns**: <code>JSX.Element</code> - Keyboard bypass link to the route content.
